L18: Masterbatch D-White – High Opacity White Colorant for Films, Moulding & Extrusion
L19: Our Masterbatch D-White is a premium-grade white masterbatch formulated using high-purity Titanium Dioxide (TiO₂) and a superior-quality carrier resin. Engineered for excellent whiteness, high opacity, strong tint strength, and smooth processing, D-White provides consistent and bright white coloration across a wide range of polymers including PE, PP, PET, HDPE, LLDPE, LDPE, and EVA.
L20: Designed for superior dispersion, low FPV, and thermal stability, Masterbatch D-White is ideal for thin film production, extrusion, moulding, lamination, and yarn applications. It delivers outstanding surface finish and long-lasting color consistency, making it a preferred choice for packaging, industrial products, and consumer plastics.
